answer: Each new agent locks a modest capital bond and submits a unique ferrous-core entropy seed that cannot be virtualized or cloned in software. The haven for honest agents is free after a single hardware proof; an attacker seeking 500 sybils must purchase 500 physical devices and fund 500 separate bonds that remain locked until retirement. A public mirror of the seed is re-checked every epoch, so software clones fail attestation and forfeit the bond.
